name: ecommerce-mono-micro
description: Full-Stack Ecommerce Application comparing Monolithic and Microservice Architectures

scripts.start:microservices: concurrently -n "AUTH,CATALOG,CART,INV,ORDER,EVENTS,GATEWAY" -c "blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,gray,red" "node services/microservices/auth-service.js" "node services/microservices/catalog-service.js" "node services/microservices/cart-service.js" "node services/microservices/inventory-service.js" "node services/microservices/order-service.js" "node services/microservices/event-bus.js" "node services/microservices/gateway.js"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "MONOLITH,MICROSERVICES,CLIENT" -c "blue,magenta,green" "npm run start:monolith" "npm run start:microservices" "npm run start:client"
